author: Silver Cymbal
description:
Most kitchen vents claim to "filter" smoke and fumes but don't work. If your tired of smoke & fumes in your kitchen you can fix it for goodœ I show you how I install a 30" kitchen range hood vent vented properly OUTDOORS, solving the issue forever. What I show here can also be used if you want to vent your over the range microwave outdoors too. This gives you cleaner air, no more annoying odors & smoke even keeps your windows and house cleaner.
